svg.title: The Humvee Cost Ladder
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-humvee-true-build-cost; chapter number: 6; title: The Humvee Cost Ladder; subtitle: How a $12,500 GovPlanet win climbs to a $35,547 full build; chart type: funnel; stages: label: Winning bid; value: 12500; display: $12,500; conversion: Starting point; detail: Hammer price on the GovPlanet Humvee.; label: After shipping and tax; value: 14800; display: $14,800; conversion: Shipping and tax stacked on; detail: Cost before the truck is road-ready.; label: Bare-bones on the road; value: 17777; display: $17,777 (about $18k); conversion: Registration, taxes, and $2,977.30 maintenance added; detail: Running total for a bare-bones truck.; label: With a few frills; value: 20000; display: About $20,000; conversion: A few frills added; detail: Modest upgrades beyond bare-bones.; label: Fully built; value: 35547; display: $35,547; conversion: Full build-out; detail: Complete build on the same $12,500 win.; caption: A basic four-man build pencils out at $21,335, including an $800 Dirt Legal titling line and $2,500 in repairs; paperwork decides value.; assumptions note: Running totals are one buyer's reported invoices and receipts; the about-$20,000 frills figure is an approximation given by the same buyer.; note: Attributed to Kevin24Seven (Vl0TRUioSn0, d2qrhLbKEbI), with SF-97 titling context from Dirt Legal (9EAPaeoXhFs).

circle.title: label: Winning bid; value: 12500; display: $12,500; conversion: Starting point; detail: Hammer price on the GovPlanet Humvee.
label: After shipping and tax; value: 14800; display: $14,800; conversion: Shipping and tax stacked on; detail: Cost before the truck is road-ready.
label: Bare-bones on the road; value: 17777; display: $17,777 (about $18k); conversion: Registration, taxes, and $2,977.30 maintenance added; detail: Running total for a bare-bones truck.
label: With a few frills; value: 20000; display: About $20,000; conversion: A few frills added; detail: Modest upgrades beyond bare-bones.
label: Fully built; value: 35547; display: $35,547; conversion: Full build-out; detail: Complete build on the same $12,500 win.

text.title: Assumptions: Running totals are one buyer's reported invoices and receipts; the about-$20,000 frills figure is an approximation given by the same buyer.
